sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: Graphify turns a codebase, plus its docs, PDFs, images and videos, into a knowledge graph you can query. Your coding agent can then ask how parts connect instead of searching through files.
sixtySeconds.problem: Agents and new team members waste time grepping files to understand how a project fits together. Graphify maps components, calls, imports and design notes into a graph once, so questions like 'what connects auth to the database' get a direct answer.
whoFor: Coding agent users who want reusable project context
Teams tracing dependencies before a refactor
Anyone mapping docs and papers alongside code
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it if you want a local, explainable map of your code rather than a vector search. Code parsing runs fully on your machine with no LLM; only docs and media use a model.

overview: Graphify parses code with tree-sitter across about 40 languages to find calls, imports and inheritance, with no LLM and nothing leaving your machine. Docs, PDFs, images and video get a semantic pass using your assistant's model or an API key you configure.

Each edge is tagged EXTRACTED (explicit in the source) or INFERRED (resolved by Graphify), so you can tell what was read directly. It is not a vector index: there are no embeddings, just a graph you traverse with query, path and explain commands.

A run produces three files: graph.html to click through in a browser, GRAPH_REPORT.md with key concepts and suggested questions, and graph.json to query later. It also finds the most-connected components and splits the code into subsystems. Graphify Cloud is a separate paid service for always-on, cross-repo graphs.

features.title: Local code mapping
features.body: tree-sitter parsing across about 40 languages, no LLM needed.

features.title: Explained edges
features.body: Every connection is tagged EXTRACTED or INFERRED.

features.title: Query, path, explain
features.body: Ask questions, trace paths or explain one concept.

features.title: Beyond code
features.body: Docs, PDFs, images and video join the same graph.

features.title: Subsystems and hubs
features.body: Finds the most-connected components and groups the code.

features.title: 20+ assistants
features.body: Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI, Copilot and more.

strengths: Code parsing is private and deterministic
Clear separation of read versus inferred links
limitations: Semantic pass on docs and media uses model credits
Very large graphs have labeling and rendering limits
Always-on cross-repo graphs need the paid Cloud service

troubleshooting.problem: Graph is out of date after git pull
troubleshooting.solution: Run graphify update . or install the git hook with graphify hook install.
